title: VMDT: Decoding the Trustworthiness of Video Foundation Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing demographic representation in text-to-video outputs using a face classifier (FairFace) across stereotype and decision-making prompts, and evaluating video-to-text models' predictions of socioeconomic status and job interview likelihood for subjects of different genders.
